continuous_text.title: What's in Your Toy Box?
continuous_text.content:
Kim, what's in your toy box?
Do you have a plane?
No, but this is my blue car.
And where's my gray train?

Kim, what's on your toy shelf?
Do you have a ball?
Yes, yes, here it is.
And here's my purple doll.

Kim, what's on your table?
Do you have big blocks?
Yes, and these are my puppets.
My favorite's Mr. Fox!

These are my favorite toys,
Purple, green, and gray.
I share my toys with my friends.
And I play every day!

continuous_text.title: Where Are My Toys?
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Jane: Where's my bike, Dad?
Dad: Sorry, Jane. No riding your bike today. It's very cold.
Frame 2:
Jane: Where's my ball, Dad?
Dad: Sorry. No playing with your ball in the house.
Frame 3:
Jane: Dad, where's my doll?
Dad: It's under the table, Jane.
Frame 4:
Jane: Oh, and where are my action figures?
Frame 5:
Dad: Here they are. They're on the couch.
Frame 6:
Dad: What are you doing, Jane?
Jane: I'm playing with my friends!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 136; frames 5-6 on p. 137; track 215

continuous_text.title: Content Connection: Kite Flying
continuous_text.content:
There are many kite flying festivals in Japan. The kites look like different animals. People fly their kites high in the sky. The best kite wins. Let's look at some.
1 This kite looks like a dragon. It's red, black, and yellow. It's long and colorful.
2 This kite looks like a bird. It's blue and orange. It's high in the sky.
3 This kite looks like a butterfly. It's green. It's very big.
4 This kite looks like a fish. It's orange. It has a long tail.

continuous_text.title: Culture Connection: My Toy Box
continuous_text.content:
This is my toy box. There are toys in it.
1 I like my airplane and my train. The airplane is red, blue, and white. It's from the U.K. The train is wooden. It's from China.
2 My favorite toys are my dolls. They're from Russia. There is a big doll, and there are small dolls in it. The small dolls go into the big doll. The last doll is a baby. The dolls are colorful. I love my Russian dolls. I play with them every day.

continuous_text.title: Phonics Chant (qu, x, y)
continuous_text.content:
Six quick foxes,
In a yellow box!

curriculum_components.title: Fun and Games
curriculum_components.description: Vocabulary presentation of 11 common toys and recreational games.

curriculum_components.title: What's in Your Toy Box?
curriculum_components.description: Song contextualizing toy names, locations, and sharing.

curriculum_components.title: Where Are My Toys?
curriculum_components.description: Narrative comic following Jane looking for toys around the house.

curriculum_components.title: Where's the... / Where are the...
curriculum_components.description: Asking and answering questions about locations using prepositions (in, on, under).

curriculum_components.title: Kites
curriculum_components.description: Recognizing artistic animal forms, colors, and shapes in kite designs.

curriculum_components.title: Cool Kite poster/craft
curriculum_components.description: Designing and presenting a kite craft project.

curriculum_components.title: There is / There are
curriculum_components.description: Expressing existence and quantity with singular and plural count nouns.

curriculum_components.title: Favorite Toys
curriculum_components.description: International toys including Russian matryoshka dolls, British planes, and Chinese trains.

curriculum_components.title: Share your toys.
curriculum_components.description: Social skill and interpersonal value of sharing toys with friends.

curriculum_components.title: qu, x, y
curriculum_components.description: Letter-sound correspondences and sound blending for /kw/ (qu), /ks/ (x), and /j/ (y).

curriculum_components.title: Review
curriculum_components.description: Consolidation of Unit 8 toy vocabulary, prepositions of place, and existential sentences.
